_about: Tools that make or check UI, one step beyond components (ADR 0007: 'maybe even image gen tools'). Each is real and runs today; `where` says where. Kind: tool.

tool:gen-image.title: Generate an image (OpenRouter)
tool:gen-image.desc: One generated image through OpenRouter, Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash Image by default. Writes NAME.png and a gen-log line with the cost. The key comes from OPENROUTER_API_KEY and is never printed.

tool:gen-image-fal.title: Generate an image (fal, Nano Banana 2.1)
tool:gen-image-fal.desc: gen-image's twin through fal.ai for when OpenRouter runs out: Nano Banana 2.1 at 1K, about $0.04 an image. FAL_KEY is read from the environment, never printed.

tool:ui-pick.title: ui-pick: rank his curated picks for a need
tool:ui-pick.desc: Ranks Shaan's curated picks against what you need, reading his own note on each; about 1.5 s and $0.0006 a call. Ranks only; you still decide by looking.

tool:pagecheck.title: uihub check <url>: a page against the rules
tool:pagecheck.desc: Checks a rendered page against the rules a script can see: box in a box, type sizes, emoji, inline colours, clickable non-buttons, motion without reduced motion; one screenshot, exit 1 on a failure.

tool:design-lab.title: design-lab: pick by looking
tool:design-lab.desc: Builds a hosted side-by-side page of real rendered options so a person picks a direction by looking, not by reading names.

tool:siso-shell-compose.title: compose: a page from a siso-shell family
tool:siso-shell-compose.desc: Renders one of the 24 page families (U0-U23) from a data file into a static page inside the SISO shell.

tool:shoot.title: shoot: headless screenshots
tool:shoot.desc: Screenshots of a URL through camofox (headless, never opens a window); one tab, closed after.
